deleteExplain: A contest admin can request deletion; the tool admin then deletes it. A full backup is saved on the server first.
deleteExplainCentral: Deleting a central contest also deletes all its project contests (each is backed up on the server first).
deleteReasonPrompt: Reason for deletion (shown to the tool admin):
deleteConfirmMsg: The contest and all its pages disappear for everybody and wait in the trash for 7 days. You can restore it or empty the trash at any time. A backup copy is also kept on the server.
deleteRequestSent: Deletion request sent to the tool admin
deleted: Moved to the trash (kept for 7 days). Backup saved on the server.
err_delete_forbidden: Only the tool admin can delete, after a contest admin requests it
err_delete_via_central: This project belongs to a central contest — request deletion there
centralFormHint: Set the shared rules here. Each project admin then adds books and everything else on their own project page.
centralPendingTitle: This central contest is awaiting approval
centralPendingDesc: The tool admin or a Wikisource administrator of one of the projects must approve it.
contestPageLinkHelp: If given, the contest name links to this page.
addBooksHint: No books yet — open this project to add Index pages.
childRulesNotice: Dates, points and some rules are set by the central contest:
allowCustomBookPoints: Allow custom points per book in this project
customPointsOff: Custom points per book are not allowed in this contest
filterPinned: Filter remembered — it stays after a refresh
distOpenDesc: any reviewer can review any page
distEqualDesc: pages are divided equally among reviewers, in book order
selectAllFilteredHint: Selects every page matching the current filters (e.g. all pages of one participant)
selectHint: Tip: click pages to select; Shift+click selects a range. Your own pages are always skipped.
err_project_has_data: This project already has contest pages and cannot be removed
err_not_assigned_to_you: This page is assigned to another reviewer
noContests: No contests found in this category.
excludedUsersLabel: Excluded Users (comma-separated, Bots are excluded automatically)
modeAcceptOnly: Accept / Reject in tool only (do not change status on Wikisource)
modeInAppValidate: Validate directly on Wikisource (updates page to Validated)
juryGetsPoints: Award validation points to reviewers when validating in tool
holdBatchRevert: Hold during contest & revert to Not Proofread in batch after contest
instantRevert: Immediately revert to Not Proofread on Wikisource upon rejection
pendingApprovalBannerTitle: This contest is awaiting administrator approval
pendingApprovalBannerDesc: The tool admin or a local Wikisource Administrator must approve this contest to activate it.
noSubmissionsYet: No pages proofread within the contest timeframe yet. Click Sync Now to refresh.
noPendingPagesInBook: No pages available for review in this filter.
firstVsLatestDiff: Inline Comparison (1st Revision vs Latest Revision)
softRemoveDesc: Stop future tracking for this book, but keep already proofread pages on the leaderboard.
hardRemoveDesc: Remove this book and delete all associated pages and points from the contest.
withReviewDesc: reviewers accept or reject each page
withoutReviewDesc: works like a Proofread Week; every eligible page counts
enableBulkReview: Enable Bulk Review (advanced, off by default)
announcementHint: Leave empty to hide. Supports [[Page|text]], [https://url text], '''bold'''
bookWindowHint: Optional. Empty = use the contest window. Dates must be inside the contest window.
bulkConfirmMsg: {action} {n} pages? This cannot be undone in one click.
centralStartedNote: This central contest has started: its start time can no longer change, and projects can be added but not removed.
noticeButtonHelp: Tell this user which pages need a fix or were not accepted
noticeNothing: No new pages to message about
noticeHelp: Posted on the talk page of {u} on the wiki, with your account. Edit it as you like.
noticeTextHelp: Your signature (~~~~) is added at the end. Pages already mentioned are not listed again next time.
err_notice_empty: Write a title and a message
err_notice_no_pages: These pages were already mentioned or changed
err_notice_failed: The wiki did not accept the message
trashHelp: Deleted contests wait here for {n} days, then they are removed for good. Only tool admins see this.
trashDeleteNowMsg: “{t}” and all its pages will be removed for good.
trashEmptyMsg: Everything in the trash will be removed for good.
discardMsg: Some changes are not saved yet. Leaving now will throw them away.
startedLockNote: This contest has started: the start time, the link slug and the Wikisource project can no longer be changed. The end time can (but not into the past).
err_slug_locked: The link slug cannot change once the contest has started
err_end_in_past: A running contest’s end time cannot be moved into the past
err_upload_too_large: The file is too large (limit: {max} MB)
warn_excluded_users: Takes effect for pages already counted: those users’ points disappear from the leaderboard at once.
warn_points: Points of pages already accepted are recalculated, so the leaderboard changes.
warn_submission_mode: Changes how new pages enter the contest; pages already listed stay.
warn_review_enabled: Changes what “accepted” means for pages already reviewed.
warn_assignment: Pending pages are shared out again between the reviewers.
warn_juries: Pending pages are shared out again if the share is equal.
warn_end_earlier: Shortening a running contest: pages after the new end will no longer count.
err_start_locked: The start time cannot change once the contest has started
err_project_locked: The Wikisource project cannot change once the contest has started
err_book_dates_outside_contest: A book’s dates must be inside the contest’s time frame
backupDesc: JSON is the complete, restorable backup (includes a checksum). CSV files are for spreadsheets. A copy is also kept on the server outside the database.
restoreDesc: The file is checked first. Before restoring, a safety copy of the current data is saved automatically. Only a backup of this same contest is accepted.
restoreConfirmMsg: All books and pages of this contest will be replaced with the backup. A safety copy of the current data is saved first.
backupReminderWeek: Reminder: no backup of this contest in the last 7 days.
backupReminderMonth: Important: this contest has never been backed up and is over a month old.
bk_page_with_unknown_book: page refers to a missing book
syncStarted: Syncing with Wikisource in the background…
syncPartial: Synced (some pages could not be checked; nothing was removed)
batchRevertConfirm: Revert rejected pages to “Not Proofread” on Wikisource (up to 50 per run)?
err_unauthorized: You do not have permission for this
err_admin_only: Only contest admins can do this
err_super_admin_only: Only the tool admin can do this
err_slug_taken: This link slug is already used
err_approve_forbidden: Only Tool Admin or local Wiki Administrators can approve contests
err_no_unproofread_pages: No unproofread pages remaining in this book
err_review_disabled: Review is turned off for this contest
err_own_page_review: You cannot review your own page
err_wiki_edit_failed: Saved in tool, but the wiki edit failed
err_page_locked: Another reviewer is on this page
err_csrf_failed: Your session changed — please reload the page and try again
err_rate_limited: Too many requests — please wait a minute and try again
err_invalid_link: The link must start with https://
bk_signature_invalid: not a backup made by this server (only the tool admin can restore it)
bookSearchHelp: Pick a suggestion, or type the full index name and press Enter. A pasted list (one book per line) is added in one go.
bookNotFound: No such index on this wiki — check the name
bookUnchecked: Could not be checked now; it will be checked when added
bookSharedHelp: These apply to every book in the list. Leave them empty to use the contest’s points and dates; each book can be changed later.
booksAddedOnSave: These books are added when you save the contest.
booksSaveNote: Books are saved one by one with their own buttons; the other tabs are saved with “Save configuration”.
wikiDomainHint: Type only the language code, e.g. “bn”.
wikiSearchPh: Language code or name: bn, as, Tamil…
err_wiki_has_data: This contest already has recorded pages, so its Wikisource project cannot be changed
popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab — the page opens here instead.
heroTitle: Turn scanned books into proofread text, together.
heroSubtitle: ProofSource follows every page proofread on Wikisource during your contest, lets reviewers check them, and keeps a live leaderboard — for any language, or many at once.
loginToTakePart: Log in with your Wikimedia account
pv_inApp: Validate on Wikisource from the tool
pv_acceptOnly: Accept / reject in the tool only
pv_hold: Revert in one batch after the contest
mode_auto_desc: every page that meets the rules is listed automatically
mode_enroll_desc: participants press “Enrol” once; only their pages are then listed automatically
mode_manual_desc: participants choose and submit their qualifying pages themselves
enrolledHint: Your qualifying pages are listed automatically
enrollDone: You are enrolled. {n} of your pages were listed.
enrollDoneNone: You are enrolled. Pages you proofread from now on are listed automatically.
submitHelp: These pages qualify for this contest (first proofread by you inside the contest time) but are not submitted yet. Select the ones you want to submit.
noEligiblePages: You have no pages waiting to be submitted.
revertedHelp: These pages were in the contest but no longer qualify — for example their status was set back to “Not proofread” on the wiki. They stay on record with 0 points and are not reviewed. If they are proofread again they return automatically.
revert_not_proofread: Status set back on the wiki
toolAdminsHelp: Tool admins can approve contests, delete contests on request and manage this list. Permanent admins come from the server configuration.
err_enrollment_closed: This contest does not use enrolment
err_manual_submission_off: This contest does not use manual submission
err_invalid_username: That is not a valid username
err_cannot_remove_root_admin: Permanent admins can only be changed in the server configuration
err_server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again in a moment.
